SELECT
  COALESCE(n.long_name, 'Unknown (!' || m.source_id || ')') AS "Node Name",
  m.source_id::text AS "Raw Node ID",
  
  -- DYNAMIC MATH: Total Packets / Total Hours Selected
  ROUND(COUNT(DISTINCT m.packet_id) / (($__to - $__from) / 3600000.0), 2) AS "Telemetry per Hour",
  
  -- DYNAMIC INTERVAL: Total Minutes Selected / Total Packets
  ROUND((($__to - $__from) / 60000.0) / COUNT(DISTINCT m.packet_id), 0)::text || ' Mins' AS "Interval",
  
  COALESCE(substring(n.last_heard_topic from '/([^/]+)/![a-fA-F0-9]+$'), 'Unknown') AS "Channel",
  COALESCE(TRIM(REPLACE(substring(n.last_heard_topic from '^msh/(.*?)/2/[ce]/'), 'US/AZ/', '')), 'Unknown') AS "Location"

FROM mesh_packet_metrics m
LEFT JOIN node_details n ON m.source_id::text = n.node_id::text

-- DYNAMIC TIME FILTER: Replaces "NOW() - INTERVAL '48 hours'"
WHERE $__timeFilter(m.time)
  AND m.portnum = 'TELEMETRY_APP'
  AND m.destination_id = '4294967295' 
GROUP BY n.long_name, m.source_id, n.last_heard_topic

-- DYNAMIC SPAM FILTER: Instead of a flat packet count, we filter by their RATE.
-- This catches anyone averaging > 1 telemetry packet per hour, regardless of the time window chosen.
HAVING (COUNT(DISTINCT m.packet_id) / (($__to - $__from) / 3600000.0)) > 1.0 

ORDER BY "Telemetry per Hour" DESC
LIMIT 20;

SELECT
  -- Use COALESCE in case a node hasn't announced its name yet
  COALESCE(n.long_name, 'Unknown (!' || n.node_id || ')') AS "Node Name",
  
  -- Expose the raw ID as text for Grafana Data Links
  n.node_id::text AS "Raw Node ID",
  
  -- DYNAMIC MATH: Total Packets / Total Hours Selected
  ROUND(COUNT(DISTINCT m.packet_id) / (($__to - $__from) / 3600000.0), 2) AS "Traceroutes per Hour",
  
  -- DYNAMIC INTERVAL: Total Minutes Selected / Total Packets
  ROUND((($__to - $__from) / 60000.0) / COUNT(DISTINCT m.packet_id), 0)::text || ' Mins' AS "Interval",
  
  -- Extracting the Channel via regex
  COALESCE(substring(n.last_heard_topic from '/([^/]+)/![a-fA-F0-9]+$'), 'Unknown') AS "Channel",
  
  -- Extracting and cleaning the Region via regex
  COALESCE(
    TRIM(
      REPLACE(
        substring(n.last_heard_topic from '^msh/(.*?)/2/[ce]/'), 
        'US/AZ/', 
        ''
      )
    ), 'Unknown'
  ) AS "Location"

FROM mesh_packet_metrics m
JOIN node_details n ON m.source_id::text = n.node_id::text

-- DYNAMIC TIME FILTER: Tied directly to the Grafana dashboard time picker
WHERE $__timeFilter(m.time)
  AND m.portnum = 'TRACEROUTE_APP'

GROUP BY n.long_name, n.node_id, n.last_heard_topic

-- DYNAMIC SPAM FILTER: Catch anyone running more than 1 trace every 2 hours (> 0.5 per hour)
HAVING (COUNT(DISTINCT m.packet_id) / (($__to - $__from) / 3600000.0)) > 0.5

ORDER BY "Traceroutes per Hour" DESC
LIMIT 20;

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  COALESCE(n.long_name, 'Unknown (!' || p.node_id || ')') AS "Node Name",
  p.node_id::text AS "Raw Node ID", 
  
  -- DYNAMIC MATH: Total Packets / Total Hours Selected
  ROUND(COUNT(DISTINCT COALESCE(p.packet_id::text, date_trunc('minute', p.time)::text)) / (($__to - $__from) / 3600000.0), 2) AS "Position Packets per Hour",

  -- DYNAMIC INTERVAL: Total Minutes Selected / Total Packets
  ROUND((($__to - $__from) / 60000.0) / COUNT(DISTINCT COALESCE(p.packet_id::text, date_trunc('minute', p.time)::text)), 0)::text || ' Mins' AS "Interval",

  -- Extracting the Channel via regex
  COALESCE(substring(n.last_heard_topic from '/([^/]+)/![a-fA-F0-9]+$'), 'Unknown') AS "Channel",
  
  -- Extracting and cleaning the Region via regex
  COALESCE(
    TRIM(
      REPLACE(
        substring(n.last_heard_topic from '^msh/(.*?)/2/[ce]/'), 
        'US/AZ/', 
        ''
      )
    ), 'Unknown'
  ) AS "Location"

FROM position_metrics p
LEFT JOIN node_details n ON p.node_id::text = n.node_id::text

-- DYNAMIC TIME FILTER: Tied directly to the Grafana dashboard time picker
WHERE $__timeFilter(p.time)
  AND p.latitude IS NOT NULL 
  AND p.longitude IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY n.long_name, p.node_id, n.last_heard_topic

-- THE STATIONARY FILTER
HAVING (MAX(p.latitude) - MIN(p.latitude)) < 0.02
   AND (MAX(p.longitude) - MIN(p.longitude)) < 0.02
   
   -- DYNAMIC SPAM FILTER: Rate-based instead of flat count
   -- Catch anyone sitting perfectly still but broadcasting > 2.0 position packets per hour
   AND (COUNT(DISTINCT COALESCE(p.packet_id::text, date_trunc('minute', p.time)::text)) / (($__to - $__from) / 3600000.0)) > 2.0 
   
ORDER BY "Position Packets per Hour" DESC
LIMIT 20;

  m.source_id::text AS "Raw Node ID",
  
  -- DYNAMIC MATH: Total Packets / Total Hours Selected
  ROUND(COUNT(DISTINCT m.packet_id) / (($__to - $__from) / 3600000.0), 2) AS "Nodeinfo per Hour",
  
  -- DYNAMIC INTERVAL: Total Minutes Selected / Total Packets
  ROUND((($__to - $__from) / 60000.0) / COUNT(DISTINCT m.packet_id), 0)::text || ' Mins' AS "Interval",

  -- Extracting the Channel via regex
  COALESCE(substring(n.last_heard_topic from '/([^/]+)/![a-fA-F0-9]+$'), 'Unknown') AS "Channel",
  
  -- Extracting and cleaning the Region via regex
  COALESCE(
    TRIM(
      REPLACE(
        substring(n.last_heard_topic from '^msh/(.*?)/2/[ce]/'), 
        'US/AZ/', 
        ''
      )
    ), 'Unknown'
  ) AS "Location"

FROM mesh_packet_metrics m
LEFT JOIN node_details n ON m.source_id::text = n.node_id::text

-- DYNAMIC TIME FILTER: Tied directly to the Grafana dashboard time picker
WHERE $__timeFilter(m.time)
  AND m.portnum = 'NODEINFO_APP'
  AND m.destination_id = '4294967295' 
GROUP BY n.long_name, m.source_id, n.last_heard_topic
